title: Rental Listing Scam Detection

blueprintSignals.name: Image reuse
blueprintSignals.definition: perceptual-hash match against an index of images seen in other listings and on other sites
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Legitimate agents reuse images across their own listings

blueprintSignals.name: Price vs market
blueprintSignals.definition: ratio of the asking rent to the median rent of similar homes nearby
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Rent control creates legitimate low rents

blueprintSignals.name: Account age and velocity
blueprintSignals.definition: number of listings posted in the first 24 hours of an account's life

blueprintSignals.name: Contact pattern
blueprintSignals.definition: share of messages that push to move off the platform or request payment
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Uses message text, so apply privacy controls

label: For "Rental Listing Scam Detection": Detect fake rental listings and advance-fee scams at posting time using text, images, price and account behaviour. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: The data contain reported scams only, which are the ones that victims noticed.
